description: Who ranks for `<term>` on Google — live organic search results (rank, title, domain, URL, snippet) for a keyword in a given country. SEO rank-tracking and SERP analysis. Example: seo_serp_google({ keyword: "best running shoes", location_code: 2840, _apiKey: "your-base64-key" })

_apiKey.description: DataForSEO API key = base64("login:password") from your dataforseo.com account

depth.description: Number of organic results to return (default 10, max 20)

keyword.description: Search query to look up, e.g. "best running shoes"

location_code.description: DataForSEO location code (default 2840 = United States). e.g. 2826 = UK, 2124 = Canada.

name: seo_serp_google
title: Seo Serp Google
